fast.purpose: Low-cost planning, review, and coordination work where speed matters more than deep code generation.

premium.purpose: Critical implementation work where correctness and code quality matter most.

economy.purpose: Routine validation, reporting, operations notes, and repeatable checks.

architect.reason: Architecture decomposition and task writing should be quick and inexpensive.

coder.reason: Coder owns real implementation changes and has the highest defect risk.

reviewer.reason: Reviewer checks scope, risks, and handoff quality with low write authority.

tester.reason: Tester runs repeatable validation and records pass/fail evidence.

ops.reason: Ops handles routine deployment notes, verification, and rollback records.

budget_guardrails.estimated_savings_target: 60-70 percent versus using premium for every role
